# Security Best Practices

> Proven patterns for tenant data isolation, time-bound access, audit trails, and authentication in multi-tenant SaaS.

## Entries

- [Customer-Controlled Support Access for Multi-Tenant SaaS](customer-controlled-support-access.md): Platform staff have zero default access to tenant data. Tenant admins issue time-bound, scope-bounded grants. Standard, break-glass, and Legal Hold workflows. SOC 2 + GDPR aligned. FOUNDATIONAL.
- [Host MCP Servers as RFC 9728/8707 OAuth 2.1 Resource Servers (Better Auth)](mcp-oauth2-resource-server.md): Per-resource protected-resource metadata + audience binding, local JWKS verification, and @better-auth/oauth-provider + jwt() over the deprecated mcp() plugin. RECOMMENDED.
- [Dual-Read Key Rotation for At-Rest Encryption Keys](dual-read-key-rotation.md): Rotate encryption keys with new-then-old decrypt fallback, lazy re-encryption, key-version tags, and a legacy-decrypt counter; never just swap the env var. RECOMMENDED.
- [Return 404, Not 403, on Cross-Tenant Lookups by ID](404-not-403-cross-tenant.md): Scope by-id queries to the caller's tenant so wrong-tenant equals not-found; 403 confirms existence and turns sequential ids into an enumeration oracle. RECOMMENDED.
- [Internal Loopback Bridge for Privileged In-Process Callers (MCP/AI tool layers)](internal-loopback-bridge.md): Tool layers loop back into the existing REST routes via a per-process randomBytes(32) secret (timingSafeEqual) carrying an id-only identity assertion re-derived server-side, so ACL/validation/audit exist in exactly one place. RECOMMENDED.
- [Link-Preview Bot Passthrough for Auth-Gated Apps](link-preview-unfurl-bot-passthrough.md): Let known unfurl-bot UAs (Teams/Slack/Outlook) GET the client-rendered page shell past auth middleware, with generateMetadata built from URL params only, so pasted links show per-resource cards without exposing data to unauthenticated scrapers. RECOMMENDED.
